displayDimensionUnit: cm in magnetic SVG; m in 3D axes

electrical.topology: isolated source -> series current sensor -> Rinternal -> L -> C -> Rload -> source return
electrical.parameterOrigin: frozen electrical R3 simulation, not a hardware kit
electrical.sourceOffMeaning: zero ideal source voltage while the series circuit remains closed, not an open switch
voltageObservations: capacitor incoming-current node minus outgoing node
electrical.currentSign: leaves source positive terminal; enters positive terminal of each passive element
electrical.idealBudget: integral(vs*i dt) = integral(Rload*i^2 dt) + integral(Rinternal*i^2 dt) + delta(0.5*L*i^2 + 0.5*C*Vc^2)
electrical.instrumentAssumption: high-impedance differential voltage probes and same synchronized series current; real instrument losses/loading excluded from fixture

variableInductanceModel.status: analytic schematic of stipulated model; not the permanent-magnet apparatus

magnetic.observable: change in apparent support force, not direct gravity measurement
magnetic.externalReaction: magnet experiences opposite magnetic force; off-balance stand carries that reaction to the tabletop
limitations: balance instrument may respond directly to field
no quantitative mapping to a solenoid L(x) model
no magnetic field or force simulation implied by drawing
